etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Medieval Latin nadir, from Arabic نَظِير السَّمْت (naẓīr as-samt), composed of نَظِير (naẓīr, “counterpart, corresponding to”) and السَّمْت (as-samt, “the zenith”).
senses: The point of the celestial sphere, directly opposite the zenith; inferior pole of the horizon; point of the celestial sphere directly under the place of observation.
(figuratively) The lowest point; time of greatest depression.
(transitive, beekeeping) To extend (a beehive) by adding an empty box at the base.
